meta.parties: Casie Chetty v. Mohamed Saleem Et Al

rules.statement: For a deed of gift between Muslims to be valid under the Muslim law, there must be an immediate transfer of dominium and possession must pass to the donee.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the case of Muslims, where the deed of gift manifests an intention to make an immediate transfer of the dominium, the Muslim law is applicable. In such a case, if possession is not given by the donor to the donee, one of the conditions essential under the Muslim law has not been complied with, and the deed of gift is invalid."
